task: subdoc-qa-mvp phase 08 counsel sheet, gate and real memory (S1-S3) + security review fix cycle (F1-F8, F11) + S3.3 no-LLM corpus
method: STRIDE pass by the execute agent over the review findings; each scenario tied to a named automated test

scenarios.scenario: Memory backend down (503 / no D1 on the live demo) blocks the counsel-sheet deliverable
scenarios.rationale: DOCX is built before any memory call; every memory step is best-effort; only a DOCX build failure throws
scenarios.test: export-flow (F1) x4; e2e counsel-export F1 case

scenarios.scenario: Queued writes replayed into a different workspace after a session/workspace change (cross-workspace write)
scenarios.rationale: ops carry workspace_id from enqueue; mismatch -> rejected workspace_changed before any request; unknown workspace -> retry without sending

scenarios.scenario: Stale question ids from an old workspace reused to answer a foreign question
Quote text, analyst notes and counsel notes linger in IndexedDB after sync
scenarios.rationale: terminal ops scrubbed on save; terminal/parked rows purged at 24 h
scenarios.test: outbox F4 scrub; outbox F4 purge

scenarios.scenario: Unbounded retry storm / ever-growing outbox while memory is unavailable
scenarios.rationale: 6-attempt cap then parked until reload/online; 503 bootstrap skips enqueue entirely

scenarios.scenario: Bidi/control characters in the analyst name spoof the audit trail (decided_by_name)
scenarios.rationale: \p{C} stripped before length check and bootstrap

scenarios.scenario: AI result computed for different firm rules accepted because the expected hash could not be computed
scenarios.rationale: null hash on a writable firm session downgrades before the call

scenarios.scenario: Sensitive numbers leak through DOCX location or sheet meta (title/firm/fund/version)
Read-only demo session writes into shared memory
scenarios.rationale: read_only from the session response disables writes up front; Worker refuses with 403 read_only
scenarios.test: review-sync 'should skip the outbox for a read-only session'; worker read_only test; preview e2e response rewrite

scenarios.scenario: Rename after session start attributes later decisions to a different server-side analyst
scenarios.rationale: accepted residual: a live sandbox keeps its server-side analyst; documented in code, UI/README note later
